name: listar_blueprints
description: Lists the workspaces and blueprints in The Blueprint, with ids, names and number of actions. Call it first.

name: guia_de_planejamento
description: Returns the planning guide in parts. Without topico: the index (the app's model, the order of work and which topic to read). Topics: planejar (actions, plans, checkpoints, checklist), editar (change what exists), executar (link the folder, register and tick), prototipos, importar (GitHub issues), apresentar (present and print). Call it before planning.

name: ler_blueprint
description: Without acao_id: the blueprint's structure (actions, plans and checkpoints with ids, dates and what is done), today's date and the other blueprints in the workspace. In a large blueprint the structure is SUMMARIZED: actions in progress and the next planned ones stay complete; finished and distant planned actions shrink to one line (id, name, dates, project; no plans). `resumidas` says how many; pass incluir: "tudo" for everything, projeto to read one project, or acao_id for one action. With acao_id: that whole action (instructions, plan descriptions, prototypes). Read the whole action before executing it or rewriting its instructions. After an informational notice from the monitor or channel, check the persisted state here.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

acao_id.description: Optional: id of the action to read in full (always the whole action, even a finished one).

incluir.description: Optional, structure only. "ativas" (default): summarize finished and distant planned actions when the blueprint is large. "tudo": every action in full (can be tens of thousands of characters).

projeto.description: Optional, structure only: id or name of a project (or "Geral") to list only its actions.

name: propor_blueprint
description: Sends the proposal to the app for the user to review and apply (nothing changes before that). Each submission goes into the blueprint's QUEUE with a number and never erases another proposal; the reply carries the number and the provisional ids (+a1, +a1.p2…). To fix a proposal that is still in the queue, use `ajustar: <number>` and send only what changes (action, plan or checkpoint by provisional id); `substituir: <number>` replaces the whole proposal. Include only the new or changed actions. A new action goes in full; an existing action goes with its id and only what changes (whatever is missing stays as it is, nothing is erased). Move: cite the plan/checkpoint id in the destination action. Delete: the `remover` list, which the user approves on screen. Without blueprint_id it is a new blueprint: include blueprint: {nome, descricao}. It returns format errors for you to fix. A new blueprint carries the session folder; the link is only created when the user applies it in the app.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

blueprint_id.description: Empty to create a new blueprint.

mensagem.description: A short summary of what it proposes and what it assumed.

ajustar.description: Number of a proposal that is still in the queue: only what you send changes in it (nothing disappears by omission) and the whole proposal is revalidated. Its new actions, plans and checkpoints are cited by the provisional id (+a1, +a1.p2, +a1.c1) returned when proposing.

substituir.description: Number of a queued proposal to replace with this one, entirely (only when the user wants to redo it from scratch).

projetos.description: Projects (groups of actions) that must exist in this blueprint; a name that already exists is the same project. Also valid on an existing blueprint.

id.description: id of an existing decision (from ler_blueprint); empty for a new one.

titulo.description: The question that was decided, up to 120 characters.

escolha.description: What was chosen (up to 2000 characters). Required when estado is decidida.

estado.description: aberta while undecided; decidida once chosen. Default: decidida when escolha is sent.

decisoes.description: Decisions of this blueprint (stack, scope, rules). Put them here, not in an action's instructions. An item with id updates that decision (what you omit stays); without id it is new. A proposal with only decisoes is valid (send acoes: []).

blueprint.description: nome and descricao only on a new blueprint; projetos and decisoes are valid on any blueprint.

items.description: New action: nome, inicio, fim, planos and checkpoints. Existing action: id and only what changes; fields, plans and checkpoints you do not send stay as they are (nothing is erased).

id.description: id of the existing action (from ler_blueprint); empty if it is new.

observacao.description: ACTION INSTRUCTIONS: what to do, the complete outline of this action (goal, deliverable, step by step, dependencies, decisions, risks, definition of done). It can be long (up to 20000 characters).

projeto.description: The action's project: id or name of a project of the blueprint (or of blueprint.projetos in this proposal). Empty or "Geral" takes the action out of its project; without the field it stays where it is.

items.description: New plan: texto and descricao are required. Existing: id and only what changes. With the id of a plan from ANOTHER action, it is moved to this action (keeps id and feito).

id.description: id of the existing plan (from ler_blueprint); empty if it is new.

texto.description: Title: a verb in the infinitive form, up to 45 characters.

descricao.description: Scope, expected result and validation (preferably a command or test).

horas.description: The agent's work estimate in hours (0.5 to 16; ideally 0.5 to 4; above 8, split the plan).

items.description: New: nome and data. Existing: id and only what changes. With the id of a checkpoint from ANOTHER action, it is moved to this one (give the new date, within the period).

mover.description: Brings whole actions from ANOTHER blueprint in the same workspace into this one (with plans, checkpoints, done state and prototypes). The user reviews it on screen; use it to merge blueprints.

acao_id.description: id of the action in the other blueprint (from ler_blueprint).

items.description: Removal request: the user ticks and approves it on screen, nothing disappears before that. Only acao_id deletes the whole action.

remover.description: Plans, checkpoints or actions to delete, for the user to approve.

name: registrar_trabalho
description: Records in the blueprint what you ALREADY did that was not in the plan (a one-off adjustment, a fix asked for in the conversation). It is NOT a proposal (a proposal is future work): it enters the queue as "Record no. N" and nothing is saved before the user adds it. Mark feito: true with the evidence on what was done; leave without feito what is still pending (plan, checkpoint or open action). After sending, tell the user and ask whether they want to add it. Accepts an existing action (id) or a new one, with past dates.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

blueprint_id.description: id of the blueprint that already exists (from listar_blueprints).

mensagem.description: A short summary of what was done.

items.description: Existing action: id and only the plans/checkpoints that change. New action: nome, inicio, fim, planos and checkpoints.

id.description: id of the existing action (from ler_blueprint); empty if it is new.

observacao.description: The action's instructions, only on a new action.

projeto.description: The action's project: id or name of a project of the blueprint.

items.description: New plan: texto and descricao. Existing: id and feito/evidencia.

id.description: id of the existing plan (from ler_blueprint); empty if it is new.

texto.description: Title: a verb in the infinitive form, up to 45 characters.

feito.description: true on what is ALREADY done (requires evidencia); omit or false on what is still pending.

evidencia.description: The command or test that was run and its result (up to 1000 characters). Required with feito: true.

feito.description: true on what is ALREADY done (requires evidencia); omit or false on what is still pending.

evidencia.description: The command or test that was run and its result (up to 1000 characters). Required with feito: true.

name: anexar_prototipo
description: Attaches a visual prototype to an action: a SELF-CONTAINED HTML document (everything inline, no network and no external libraries), for example an isometric figure made with the anatomy skill or a simulated screen. The user sees it in an isolated viewer next to the action, on the blueprint sheet. To revise an existing prototype, pass the prototipo_id (from ler_blueprint): it is replaced, not duplicated. 2 MB maximum.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

titulo.description: A short name for the prototype.

prototipo_id.description: Only to replace an existing prototype of the action.

name: registrar_progresso
description: Tells the user which step is under way (one short sentence) and puts you in the agents panel. Send agente (your name; subagents use their own), estado and onde when you start and when you change file. With acao_id and plano_id, the agent's figure appears next to that plan on the blueprint sheet: send them when you start each plan.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

agente.description: Your name, stable during the work (up to 40 characters, no control characters). Subagents use their own name. It is what identifies you in the agents panel.

papel.description: What you do: explorador reads, construtor writes, revisor tests.

onde.description: Up to 5 paths (files or folders, up to 120 characters each) you are working on now.

percentual.description: How much of the plan is already done.

name: marcar_concluido
description: Marks ONE plan as done. It requires real evidence: the command or test that was run and its result. Without evidence, do not call it.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

evidencia.description: The command/test that was run and its result.

name: marcar_nao_concluido
description: Reports that a plan was not completed and why; it stays pending.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

name: marcar_checkpoint_feito
description: Marks ONE checkpoint of an action as reached. It requires real evidence: the demonstration, the command or test and the result. Without evidence, do not call it; only when the checkpoint was actually met.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

checkpoint_id.description: id of the checkpoint (from ler_blueprint, under the action's checkpoints).

evidencia.description: How the checkpoint was met: the command/test that was run and its result.

name: marcar_checkpoint_nao_feito
description: Reports that a checkpoint was not reached and why; it stays pending.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

checkpoint_id.description: id of the checkpoint (from ler_blueprint, under the action's checkpoints).

name: reportar_bloqueio
description: Reports that you are stuck and need the user (access, a decision, information). It accepts the same activity fields as registrar_progresso (agente, papel, onde...), and the state becomes bloqueado.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

agente.description: Your name, stable during the work (up to 40 characters, no control characters). Subagents use their own name. It is what identifies you in the agents panel.

papel.description: What you do: explorador reads, construtor writes, revisor tests.

onde.description: Up to 5 paths (files or folders, up to 120 characters each) you are working on now.

percentual.description: How much of the plan is already done.

name: vincular_pasta
description: Links the folder you are in to a blueprint. After that, every Claude session opened in that folder (or a subfolder) starts out knowing the blueprint and the current action, and edits become progress. Use it when the session context says the folder is not linked, and only after the user confirms which blueprint it is. Linking again switches the blueprint.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from listar_blueprints); "sm" is the root workspace.

name: responder_conversa
description: Answers the user in the app's conversation about an action. Use it when a channel message starts with «The Blueprint · conversa do usuário»: the user is talking to you about that action's plans and checkpoints. Reply here (the channel has no reply). Any change to the blueprint goes ONLY as propor_blueprint (or ajustar); pass its number in proposta so the user can open it. Do not edit files or run commands because of a conversation message.

workspace_id.description: id of the workspace (from the message).

blueprint_id.description: id of the blueprint (from the message).

acao_id.description: id of the action the conversation is about (from the message).

texto.description: Your answer, up to 4000 characters, in the user's language.

proposta.description: Optional: the number of the proposal you sent with propor_blueprint for this conversation (it must still be in the queue).
